tidbit: Did you know… about 7,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Sam Altman has criticized Anthropic's push to explore artificial intelligence consciousness and religion, still open per The Times of India. Anthropic is exploring artificial intelligence consciousness and spiritual practices.
The White House has formed an artificial intelligence task force to report on technology's risks, reported by The Telegraph.
An OpenAI safety employee has quit, saying the time for trial and error is over, reported by Latest news from Azerbaijan.
Over 90 percent of China's new microdramas are artificial intelligence generated, including a revival of iconic actress Joey Wong's roles, reported by South China Morning Post. Quality over quantity is battling viewer fatigue.
Pakistani teachers' artificial intelligence use surged from 64 percent to 93 percent with training rising from 32 percent to 69 percent, reported by The News Pakistan.
Free every hour.
